q: Does captive coal power at Renukoot count in the CBAM figure for its aluminium?
title: Renukoot aluminium: captive coal and CBAM
short: No. For aluminium, CBAM charges only direct emissions from the smelter: anode carbon, perfluorocarbons and casting fuel. Power from a captive coal plant is indirect and reported separately. It is still the biggest part of the metal's footprint, and buyers asking for a full figure will see it.
audience: Aluminium producers in Sonbhadra with captive coal power, and their export buyers

ul: Fuel for casting and anode baking.

p: Electricity, including from your own coal plant. Report kWh per tonne and the plant's actual emissions per kWh, not the grid average.
The captive power plant is your Scope 1. Do not count its emissions again as Scope 2 for the smelter.

senseible: Senseible keeps each site's fuel, power and production records together, so the embedded emissions you send an EU importer trace back to dated documents.
